description: Offline file-processing CLI with local filesystem input only; no network, service, account, or tenant boundary. No destructive-write behavior is authorized. Packaging and local recovery are conditional on distribution and write behavior. No tests, CI, or release execution occurred.
missing_inputs: precise file formats and size limits
recovery requirements if future writes are authorized
whether results are stdout, a new output path, or in-place changes
acceptance_boundary: Offline local-file CLI only. Require clear arguments/help, predictable stdout/stderr and exit status, bounded local input handling, and non-destructive defaults. Do not represent tests/CI/release as executed. Packaging and local recovery are conditional; no service rollback/deployment.
